logp.method_description: The octanol–water partition coefficients (P) of [CuL]+ and 1–6 were determined using a shake-flask method.62 Tris-HCl buffer and n-octanol (SRL) were shaken together for 24 h to allow the saturation of both phases. Stock solutions of [CuL]+ and 1–6 (1 mmol) were prepared in the aqueous phase, and aliquots (1 mL) of each of these stock solutions were then added to an equal volume of the n-octanol phase. The concentrations of the complexes in the organic and aqueous phases were then determined using UV absorbance spectroscopy. Log P is defined as the logarithm of the ratio of the concentration of the complex in the organic phase to that in the aqueous phase.
